question: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular decagon?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon**, the sum of all **exterior angles** is always 360°.

A **decagon** has **n = 10** sides.

Each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n = 360° ÷ 10 = 36°.

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Shape = **Regular Decagon**.

**Formula Used:** Each Exterior Angle of a regular polygon = 360° ÷ n, where n is the number of sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a2b72e1261369c8a63c48343eccdefc3b8f9544fd31dcbe167743db8bd0cdf4.png] 

⇒ Number of sides in a **decagon** (n) = 10.

⇒ Sum of all exterior angles of any **convex polygon** = 360°.

⇒ Since the polygon is **regular**, all exterior angles are equal.

⇒ Each exterior angle = 360° ÷ 10.

⇒ Each exterior angle = 36°.

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle of a Regular Polygon

Each interior angle is given by [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n. For a decagon, it is [(10 − 2) × 180°] ÷ 10 = 144°.

Relation between Interior and Exterior Angles

The sum of an **interior angle** and its corresponding **exterior angle** is always 180° (linear pair).

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is (n − 2) × 180°.</p
